investigation_notes.Description: The Vitalis Healthcare logo was found on a newly-registered domain (vitalis-care-verification.net) that displays an urgent "Patient Information Update Required" page with form fields requesting SSN and other PII. The domain is one day old, hosted on an IP with a poor reputation (0/100) from a data center provider, and the scanned URL does not match the official brand domain (vitalis.com); no recent similar alerts or partner association were identified. The combination of a pixel-accurate logo on an unauthorized, newly-registered domain plus visible PII collection indicates impersonation and credential/PII harvesting, so this is classified as High Priority.
